review.reviewer: Codex CLI / GPT-6, read-only, independent of the author session
findings: Pass 1 blocking: fixed-speed flow floor admitted reverse flow below it; resolved by a bounded per-state aero-negligibility approximation with an explicit force bound and full support checks above it.
Pass 1 blocking: legacy motor validation missed nonfinite masses and zero impulse; resolved with candidate-specific validation before the shared primitive.
Pass 1 blocking: non-unit quaternions could form nonorthogonal frames; resolved with the shared near-unit attitude policy.
Pass 1 should-fix: atmosphere domain checked only at launch; resolved at instantaneous altitude in query, curves and trajectory.
Pass 1 should-fix: incomplete declared parachute could become absent; resolved with an explicit refusal.

Pass 2 high: canopy force inherited the legacy 1e-6 m/s floor, canopy Mach support was bypassed by the negligible branch, and a stationary canopy status precedence was wrong; all three resolved and re-reviewed.
